text: i can't see let's make it brighter

A.rule: ambiguous: 'can't see' is declared light_power(on) (R6) but the explicit ask 'make it brighter' is relative [] (R4)

B.rule: R4: 'make it brighter' relative; 'can't see' is the reason

text: turn all lights on and please turn off all the lights in my house

A.rule: two supported actions as multiset (R2); 'all lights' and 'my house' = whole house

B.rule: R2 gives both calls but on+off whole house contradict; order-free multiset cannot express intended end state

text: give me dark

A.rule: 'dark' is not a colour; off vs dim not decided by wording (R6 needs exactly one call)

B.rule: R6: asks for darkness, lights off in here

text: make sure to remind about tomorrows afternoon meeting

A.rule: time-of-day word without clock time on a reminder (§3 Times)

B.rule: §3 reminder about named event; no reminder time, default 09:00 tomorrow

text: thursday at three p. m. there is a teachers meeting i need to be reminded of and don't ever play old list again

A.rule: served reminder (thursday 15:00, teachers meeting) + negated music instruction: contract does not decide whether a negated unsupported clause triggers R1

B.rule: reminder served (thursday 3 pm); negated clause yields no call under R3

text: please tell me to take my umbrella because it will be very hot today

A.rule: indirect reminder; reason ignored R8; default time 09:00 next occurrence

B.rule: 'tell me to' reminder with date today and default time 09:00 already past; contract does not decide past default time on a stated date

A.rule: R1 'for today' date qualifier on list add not expressible

B.rule: to do list = to-do; one item

text: set a reminder alarm for my five p. m. meeting please

A.rule: contract does not decide reminder vs alarm for 'reminder alarm' for a 5 pm meeting

B.rule: 'reminder alarm' does not decide set_alarm(17:00) vs create_reminder(meeting,17:00)
